target_moa.text: Nemolizumab-ilto is a humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody that inhibits IL-31 signaling by binding selectively to the IL-31 receptor alpha (IL-31RA), competitively blocking binding of IL-31 and subsequent activation of the JAK/STAT pathway. IL-31 is a cytokine involved in pruritus, inflammation, epidermal dysregulation, and fibrosis.

citations.quote: Nemolizumab-ilto is a humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody that inhibits IL-31 signaling by binding selectively to IL-31 RA. IL-31 is a naturally occurring cytokine that is involved in pruritus, inflammation, epidermal dysregulation, and fibrosis.

Nemolizumab is a humanized anti-human interleukin-31 receptor A (IL-31RA) monoclonal antibody which competitively blocks the binding of IL-31 to its receptor and subsequent activation of JAK/STAT pathway and transduction of the IL-31 signal into the cell.

Nemolizumab is a humanized monoclonal IgG2 antibody recognizing the interleukin-31 receptor alpha chain (IL-31RA) and blocking binding of IL-31, a cytokine secreted by activated T cells, induces itch, barrier disruption, skin inflammation, and fibrosis.

key_safety.text: No deaths were reported with nemolizumab in the phase 3 trials; serious adverse events were more common in placebo. Most common adverse reactions (≥1% and more frequent than placebo) through Week 16: headache (6% vs 3%), dermatitis atopic (4% vs 0.5%), eczema (4% vs 2%), and eczema nummular (3% vs 0%). Hypersensitivity reactions (e.g., facial angioedema) have been reported.

citations.quote: No deaths were reported in subjects treated with nemolizumab during the phase 3 trials. Serious adverse events were more common in the placebo treated patients.

The most common adverse reactions reported at a frequency of \ge 1\% in the nemolizumab group through Week 16 (and more frequently than in the placebo group) included headache (6% vs. 3%), dermatitis atopic (4% vs. 0.5%), eczema (4% vs. 2%), and eczema nummular (3% vs. 0%).
Hypersensitivity reactions, such as facial angioedema, have been reported with use of NEMLUVIO.
